title: Scientific Project Manager – Horizon Europe – Physical Activity and Healthy Ageing
full_detail: Manage a Horizon Europe consortium in physical activity and healthy ageing. PhD preferred. Responsibilities include research project coordination, grant management, proposal development, international consortium work and scientific reporting.

title: EU Project Manager – Renewable Energy
full_detail: Manage EU funded renewable energy and solar infrastructure projects, including industrial engineering partners.

title: Clinical Research Coordinator – Rehabilitation and Exercise
full_detail: Coordinate human intervention studies in rehabilitation and exercise. Support randomized controlled trials, participant assessments, physiological testing, questionnaires, data quality and statistical analysis. MSc or PhD in health sciences preferred.

title: Senior CRA Oncology
full_detail: At least 5 years of CRA clinical monitoring and site monitoring experience in Phase I oncology trials required. Pharmaceutical industry experience essential.

title: Postdoctoral Researcher – Exercise Neuroscience
full_detail: Postdoctoral researcher in exercise neuroscience and physical activity. PhD required. The project includes randomized exercise interventions, cognitive assessments, physiological measures, statistical analysis in R and scientific publications.

title: Project Manager – SAP Migration
full_detail: Lead SAP migration, ERP implementation and enterprise IT transformation projects.

title: Digital Health Researcher – Behaviour Change and Physical Activity
full_detail: Research role in digital health, behaviour change and physical activity interventions. Conduct human studies, questionnaires and statistical analysis. Remote across the EU; candidates may work from Spain.

title: Researcher – Molecular Oncology
full_detail: Researcher in molecular oncology and drug discovery. Mandatory flow cytometry, cell culture and mass spectrometry experience.

title: Scientific Project Officer – Neuroscience
full_detail: Scientific project officer supporting international neuroscience and brain health projects, grant reporting, proposal development, consortium coordination and scientific communication. Remote in Europe with Spain eligible.
